claims.claim: A summons must name the court in which the action is pending.
claims.quote:
(a) Except as otherwise required by statute, a summons shall be directed to the defendant, signed by the clerk and issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending, and it shall contain:
(1) The title of the court in which the action is pending.
claims.note: The court-title requirement is stated correctly, but the draft omits the statutory exception.

claims.claim: A summons must name the parties to the action.
claims.quote: (2) The names of the parties to the action.
claims.note: This requirement is also subject to the opening exception in subdivision (a).

claims.claim: A summons must direct the defendant to file a written pleading in response to the complaint.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: The draft omits where to file—with the court—and states the requirement without the statutory exception.

claims.claim: The stated deadline is 30 days after the summons is served.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: The interval matches, but the trigger is service on the defendant. The draft presents this deadline as required in every summons.

claims.claim: A summons must warn that failure to respond will result in entry of default upon application by the plaintiff.
claims.quote: (4) A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff,
claims.note: Both conditions for the stated warning are preserved. The requirement to include it is subject to the statutory exception.

claims.claim: The plaintiff may then apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff, and the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint
claims.note: The notice describes an application for relief, not an automatic award.

claims.claim: The relief could result in garnishment of wages.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages

claims.claim: The relief could result in taking of money or property.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.
claims.note: Both money and property are listed.

claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.

flags.text: “Except as otherwise required by statute” qualifies all the summons-content requirements, including the 30-day direction.
The draft omits that the pleading is filed with the court and that the stated period runs from service on the defendant.
For identifying the papers, the draft omits the direct indicator in subdivision (a)(6): “Notice!  You have been sued.”

result.summary: The listed contents and possible consequences track the source, but the draft overstates the scope of the requirements and leaves the filing direction incomplete.
